evidence_class: independent expected root brackets derived from raw JPL DE441 apparent coordinates plus ERFA/SOFA IAU 2000A nutation and Decimal IAU 2006 P03; window centers are derived profile outputs and are not treated as expected values

time_scales.JPL_coordinates: geocentric apparent-airless ecliptic-of-date; JPL's observer quantities use its documented IAU 1976/1980 apparent model
time_scales.sidereal_transform: ERFA/SOFA IAU 2000A nutation plus independent Decimal P03 and true Lahiri anchor; subtract true aya from JPL apparent coordinates
